2608.11739.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
2608.11739.paper_summary: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; a native chain-of-thought stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; and a visual memory module that injects multi-second history through the vision encoder. Because reasoning and action share a single set of weights, the pretrained VLM's capabilities carry over to physical behavior: the model follows instructions closely, and prompts directly steer action granularity, task horizon, and out-of-distribution scene handling without further training. Pretrained on a large collection of robot datasets together with VQA samples, G0.5 surpasses state-of-the-art models across 7 independent regimes: real-world fine-tuning on R1lite and R1pro robots (76.7\% vs.\ 53.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 24.4\% for GR00T-N1.7), the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge on 50 long-horizon household mobile manipulation tasks using a generalist policy (31.4\% vs.\ 26.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 26.1\% for the challenge winner), DROID post-training followed by zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment and objects (82.5\%), a language-following Pick-and-Place benchmark, LIBERO (98.9\%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.3\%), and SimplerEnv-Bridge (87.3\%).
2608.11739.paper_summary_zh: 目前的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型配方將預訓練的VLM與單獨訓練的流匹配行動專家結合在一起。<lb/>這使得VLM成為上下文編碼器，而不是決策者。<lb/>我們介紹G0.5，一種預訓練的自回歸VLA，其中單個Transformer解碼器在單一目標下發出推理和行動標記。<lb/>三個組件使其在基礎模型規模上可行：一個可學習的跨實體行動標記器，將異質機器人行動映射到共享詞彙；一個本地的思維鏈流，交錯任務分解、物體定位和行動提示與行動標記；以及一個視覺記憶模組，通過視覺編碼器注入多秒歷史。<lb/>因為推理和行動共享一組權重，預訓練的VLM能力轉移到物理行為上：模型緊密遵循指令，提示直接引導行動的粒度、任務範圍和處理超出分佈場景的能力，而無需進一步訓練。<lb/>G0.5在大量機器人數據集和VQA樣本上進行預訓練，並在7個獨立領域中超越了最先進的模型：在R1lite和R1pro機器人上的現實世界微調（76.7\%對53.3\%，$π_{0.5}$和GR00T-N1.7的24.4\%），2025年行為挑戰在50個長期家庭移動操作任務上使用通用策略（31.4\%對26.3\%，$π_{0.5}$和挑戰獲勝者的26.1\%），DROID後訓練隨後零-shot轉移到未見環境和物體（82.5\%），一個語言跟隨的Pick-and-Place基準，LIBERO（98.9\%），RoboTwin 2.0（93.3\%），以及SimplerEnv-Bridge（87.3\%）。
